restrictions: Two distinct 64-byte messages with equal digests for the Orchard hash with 56 partial rounds (poseidon-orchard-r56-prefix-v1), found as a collision F(x) = F(y), x != y, of the walk F(x) = digest(message(kappa x - E0_0)) / OUTSCALE_kappa: message() is the injective parametrisation of the input line on which rounds 0 and 1 are affine, kappa a random nonzero coin. Birthday search, one trail with distinguished points (x < (2^126 + 1) T, T = 51298), one bit-packed table (142-bit value, 119-bit index gap per entry, MCAP = 26389), single-gap recovery (credit 43caeb6a), one evaluation budget B shared by the trail and the recovery (recovery at most RCAP = 2^119 of it); no detection window, lockstep cap or positioning cap. Base package 69e14209.

Cost model orchard-field-ram-v2, C = 1392. Field ADD and MUL 1/C each; every other primitive 256-bit word operation (AND, OR, shift, comparison, conditional branch, move, load, store, random word) 1/C; a comparison and a conditional branch are two operations. Every evaluation executes the 807-operation step program (329 ADD, 478 MUL; proof.md Section 2, Appendix C), unchanged from 69e14209. The 327 step constants are kappa-monomials set per attempt (1,237 operations, charged) in a declared file of 387 registers counted in memory.

Ledger (proof.md Section 6, instruction listings): at most B = 169218744542297554673723788714208919584 evaluations in all (one down-counter for the trail and the recovery); a trail step is 807 + 2 operations (CMPLT, BZ), plus 2 per block of 47 unrolled steps; a recovery evaluation 807 + 8 (one subroutine copy of STEP, CALL/RET charged), at most RCAP = 2^119 of them; worst case B (807 + 2) + 2 B / 47 + 6 RCAP; table, index passes, messages, constants and setup 13,234,566,466 operations; offline derivation (--tune with 129 cells, one run of plan, the recipe search and build_step: at most 2^43.18 word operations at the prices of the integer routines of Section 6a) charged at 2^58. Total 136909152816346174246945532967693507464738 operations, log2(total / 1392) = 126.2093273, claimed 126.20933 (rounded up). One attempt; no restart, amplification or advice.

Memory (proof.md Section 7, allocation list): table 26,906 words (26,389 packed entries of 261 bits and one pad word) 860,992, start word 32, 39,819 instructions at 4 bytes 159,276, constants 10,816, register file 12,384, kappa setup 5,056: 1,048,556 bytes, below 2^20. Output in registers. The offline derivation runs first in the table's address range (code at most 65,536 bytes, data at most 262,144 bytes; live peak 515,244 bytes with the resident items), which the setup zeroes before the attempt (Section 7).

Success probability at least 0.39 under the declared premise H1: Lemma 4 (proof.md Section 5) proves 0.39000000099103583039 for a uniformly random function at the filed budget, by coupling the three recovery gaps to independent geometric variables independent of the collision time (Lemma 3) and bounding the trail law convolved with them through their moment generating function; H1 carries it to the real map (Section 8: deviation model and the price of a margin). The program is printed in proof.md Appendix B (standard library only). Two organizer-run experiments (search-w14-raw-bits, trail-w14-exact-walk; Section 9), observations only. No full collision is produced or claimed; the claim is the cost of the search.

heuristics.statement: At the filed budget B = 169218744542297554673723788714208919584 evaluations, where Lemma 4 gives 0.39000000099 for a uniformly random function, the search of proof.md Section 3 on the real map F(x) = digest(message(kappa x - E0_0)) / OUTSCALE_kappa, with the coins of the attempt (proof.md Section 1: kappa and x_0 the low 254 bits of two uniform 256-bit words), succeeds with probability at least 0.39.
heuristics.scope: Target poseidon-orchard-r56-prefix-v1, inputs on the line of proof.md Section 1, one trail with the parameters of Section 3 (B = 1.6922e38 evaluations for the trail and the recovery together). Only the success probability rests on it; the step program, recovery, evaluation count, ledger and memory are proved or checked exactly (Sections 2, 4, 6, 7).
heuristics.extrapolation: Organizer-run experiments (Section 9) on the claim's input line, with the coin law of the attempt: search-w14-raw-bits runs this search (DP test, table, shared budget, recovery allowance, single-gap recovery) at width 14 on the map x -> the 14 low digest bits of digest(message(kappa x - E0_0)), which is F without the division by OUTSCALE_kappa (random-map reference 0.4764, our measurement); trail-w14-exact-walk runs the walk F itself at full width for 128 outputs and tests the first repeat of the 14 low bits of its raw digests against the independent-uniform value 0.3919. Their counts are reproducible observations consistent with the premise; no probability is inferred from them. H1 carries the random-map behaviour of F to the full-width search over 2^127 steps. Deviation model (Section 8): a random map on N / c points with the same DP fraction gives 0.3900, 0.3591, 0.3098, 0.2566 at c = 1, 0.9, 0.75, 0.6; restoring 0.39 with a margin epsilon costs log2(1 + epsilon) bits (0.0144 at 1 %).
heuristics.limitations: H1 is not proved; it concerns the average over the coin kappa, which is what Lemma 4 bounds. No experiment runs the full-width search of about 2^127 steps. search-w14-raw-bits omits the division by OUTSCALE_kappa of F, a bijection of the field that does not in general preserve trajectories, and at width 14 the gaps are not small beside the trail; trail-w14-exact-walk runs F at full width but only its trail, not the table or the recovery. The deviation table holds under its stated random-map model only. The success bound assumes nothing about the organizer-seeded trials (no independence or identical distribution of the trials is used).
